newsitem.title: USA: ICOS, Alanex in small molecule drug pact.
newsitem.headline: ICOS, Alanex in small molecule drug pact.

text.p: ICOS Corp said on Thursday it signed an exclusive agreement with Alanex Corp to collaborate on the discovery of small molecule drugs.
The companies said under the agreement, ICOS would provide the undisclosed molecular target, development of the initial assay systems, secondary assays and preclinical models.
Alanex would be responsible for design and synthesis of exploratory compound libraries, high through-put screening and combinatorial chemistry optimization, it said.

Both parties would contribute equally in the resource allocation of the collaboration and funding of development, and would also share in commercial rights to any products that were discovered through the collaboration, they said.
